cancellation.title: Cancellation & Rescheduling Policy
rules: Standard Bookings: Free cancellation or reschedule up to 2 hours prior to the booked service slot.
Tri-Combo Luxury Suite members enjoy zero cancellation fees on all bookings anytime before provider dispatch.
If a booking is cancelled within the permitted window, the service coin is instantly credited back to your active monthly balance.
Late cancellations after the provider is already en route may forfeit that session coin to compensate the dedicated specialist.

coinsAndEntitlements.title: Luxora Coin & Entitlement Rules
rules: 1 Coin = 1 Standard Service Session in the designated category (Auto, Garden, or Pet).
Coins are replenished monthly on your subscription billing date.
Coins are tied to their designated service tier to guarantee vetted specialists for that specific discipline.
Unused coins remain active throughout your subscription billing cycle.

serviceLimitsAndExceedance.title: Exceeding Standard Limits
rules: If your estate or fleet requires visits beyond your monthly package allowance, you may book additional single visits at member-discounted individual rates.
For custom estate layouts, commercial-scale grounds, multi-vehicle fleets, or exotic pet habitats, submit a Special Ask request for bespoke scheduling.

kycAndSecurity.title: Provider KYC & Trust Standards
rules: 100% of Luxora specialists undergo background verification, police clearance, and skill certifications.
All services are fully insured, with GPS-tracked arrivals and verified check-in/check-out timestamps.
